TABLE.NAME: local_parce_conversation_entries
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores conversation entries for audit and history tracking

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary key

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who participated in the conversation

FIELD.NAME: chatid
FIELD.COMMENT: Chat context identifier (cm, course or site)

FIELD.NAME: conversationkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Unique conversation identifier (userid_chatid_sessionid)

FIELD.NAME: question
FIELD.COMMENT: User question

FIELD.NAME: response
FIELD.COMMENT: System response

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the entry was created

INDEX.NAME: userid_chatid_idx
INDEX.COMMENT: Index for user and chat lookups

TABLE.NAME: local_parce_ai_actions
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores AI transaction logs for local_parce question processing

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who triggered the action

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle context ID where the action was executed

FIELD.NAME: chatid
FIELD.COMMENT: Chat context identifier (course context id or SITEID)

FIELD.NAME: conversationkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Conversation session key (SHA256 hash)

FIELD.NAME: conversationentryid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_parce_conversation_entries linking this action to the conversation turn

FIELD.NAME: actiontype
FIELD.COMMENT: Type of AI call: question_plan or answer_question

FIELD.NAME: intent
FIELD.COMMENT: Detected intent type: base, content, greeting, help

FIELD.NAME: intentparams
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-encoded intent parameters returned by the question_plan step

FIELD.NAME: prompt
FIELD.COMMENT: System instruction prompt sent to the AI

FIELD.NAME: prompttext
FIELD.COMMENT: Full hackquestion text sent as user prompt

FIELD.NAME: generatedcontent
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw AI response content

FIELD.NAME: success
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if the AI call was successful, 0 otherwise

FIELD.NAME: errorcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Error code if the call failed

FIELD.NAME: errormessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Error message if the call failed

FIELD.NAME: responseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Unique response identifier returned by the AI provider

FIELD.NAME: fingerprint
FIELD.COMMENT: Backend configuration fingerprint from the AI provider

FIELD.NAME: finishreason
FIELD.COMMENT: Reason the model stopped generating tokens

FIELD.NAME: prompttokens
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of tokens in the prompt

FIELD.NAME: completiontokens
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of tokens in the completion

FIELD.NAME: model
FIELD.COMMENT: AI model used for this request

FIELD.NAME: provider
FIELD.COMMENT: Real provider plugin that processed the request

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the action was created

FIELD.NAME: timecompleted
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the AI response was received
